name: io.github.fish827-08/kb-memory
title: kb — Local Memory & Knowledge Service
description: Local-first agent memory service: hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25/RRF) with memory governance (decay, semantic dedup, freshness weighting). Single process, works fully offline without any LLM. Store memories and documents via REST or MCP, search them from Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: KB_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for the ChromaDB store and runtime files (defaults to ./kb_data)

environmentVariables.name: KB_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Empty = auto-detect; set 'cpu' or 'cuda' to override

environmentVariables.name: KB_EMBED_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model (default BAAI/bge-m3; lightweight option BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5)

environmentVariables.name: KB_LLM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: local | auto | cloud — RAG answering mode; memory write/search works without any LLM

environmentVariables.name: KB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the REST service auth (empty = no auth, localhost only)
